standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4427-4428)

standard_prerequisites.name: The preservation of the Gorenstein property under a flat local homomorphism with Gorenstein fibre
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4443-4444 and 4447)

standard_prerequisites.name: The Gorenstein property of a regular ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source line 4442)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the Gorenstein fibre in the regular case.

core_obligations: Part (A): present the finitely generated field extension as the fraction field of a global complete intersection, so that the base change is a relative global complete intersection and hence Gorenstein, and the desired fibre is a localization of it (proof lines 4420-4429)
Part (B): a ring is Gorenstein exactly when all its local rings are (proof lines 4431-4433)

Parts (C) and (D): reduce to a regular local homomorphism, where the source is Gorenstein and the fibre is regular hence Gorenstein, and apply the flat preservation statement; part (D) uses the same statement, and (E) does not refer to the ground field (proof lines 4435-4448)
proof_roadmap: 可先假定所论环是 Cohen-Macaulay（Gorenstein 的性质已证）。
(A)：把 K/k 写成整体完全交 A = k[x]/(f) 的分式域；R → R ⊗_k A 是相对整体完全交 ⇒ 由 gorenstein-lci 得 R ⊗_k A Gorenstein ⇒ 局部化 R ⊗_k K 亦然。
(B) 由局部性；(C) 化为 B → C 正则局部同态：B Gorenstein、C/m_B C 正则（由 regular-gorenstein）⇒ 由 flat-under-gorenstein 得 C Gorenstein；(D) 同引理；(E) 与基域无关。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement verifies the five permanence properties of the formal fibres section for the property of being a Gorenstein ring (author lemma at source lines 4407-4412, label lemma-formal-fibres-gorenstein). The proof (source lines 4414-4449) handles (A) by dominating the field extension by a global complete intersection and using permanence under the resulting local complete intersection extension, (B) by locality, (C) and (D) by reducing to a regular local homomorphism whose fibre is regular and applying the flat preservation statement, and (E) because the condition does not mention the ground field (proof lines 4420-4448). Parts (A) and (C) are the substance. H3.
